semantics.rust_signature: fn equal_exact_native(input: &Tensor, other: &Tensor, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<bool, ElementwiseRuntimePartNineteenError>
semantics.shape_rule: false for unequal shapes and elementwise comparison for equal shapes
semantics.dtype_rule: supports canonical numeric cross-dtype equality without promotion storage
semantics.accumulation_dtype: exact signed, unsigned, or f64 decoded comparison
semantics.layout_rule: logical traversal supports views and noncontiguous inputs
semantics.numeric_rule: all corresponding numeric values must compare equal; NaN is unequal and signed zero is equal
semantics.determinism: logical index order with early false return
semantics.cancellation_points: before traversal, bounded intervals, and before true publication
